spec_match.rationale: Uses audioEndTime against the result event's timeStamp to derive processing lag — a real composition of the new attribute with existing event timing, with the fallback framing carefully scoped.

interactive.rationale: Monitor controls work; without a backend the page lands in its labelled unavailable state with the threshold controls still explorable.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The lede is precise that the signal informs but does not authorize a fallback — good spec hygiene.

edge_cases.rationale: No-SR, null-timestamp, recognition-error and measured branches each have their own assert id and UI state.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Unavailable branch exercised for real here; console clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: Four branch asserts, all literal-true conditions with distinguishing details.

accessibility.rationale: Controls labelled, aria-live readouts, visible focus.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. Honest unavailable-state behaviour; live latency numbers need a speech-capable machine (tracked on capability-probe).
